raw_comment: When looking at this graph I noticed that the states which are more landlocked are experiencing the greatest droughts. This does however have a few exceptions such as Colorado which still does have drought but less than other states. I wonder if there is any coloration between global warming and the increased droughts that America is experiencing as a whole due to the rising temperatures. This relates to me and my community because we recently experienced a drought that lasted two months. This led to fires in states such as New Jersey. A catchy title could be, "The U.S. is going through a period of severe drought. What can we do to prevent this?"
